Child Secure: if the policyholder dies, remaining premiums are waived and income continues; if the child dies, the greater of 10x annualised premium or 105% of premiums paid to date is paid and the policy ends.

Factor varies by entry age, premium paying term, policy term, payout period, premium and option. Under Child Secure, payouts need all premiums paid. Policy ends once all income is paid.
benefits.other: Life cover for the full policy term; optional waiver of premium on accidental total permanent disability (exclusions apply); flexible income accumulation option; Dhanlakshmi benefit raises the guaranteed income factor by 1.5% for a female child under Child Secure, chosen at inception only; suicide within 12 months of risk start or revival pays the nominee or beneficiary 80% of premiums paid or surrender value, whichever is higher, with no interest.
